evidence: Has the Validation label and alters AssumeUTXO snapshot import logic in src/validation.cpp and src/node/utxo_snapshot.h.
rationale: Tightens AssumeUTXO snapshot validation by ensuring metadata coin counts match imported coins and rejecting zero-coin transaction groups. While content hash checks already protect consensus state, duplicate outpoints could inflate reported counts and empty groups could bypass loop interrupt checks during shutdown (PR description).
